parts:
Hello LAVAAN members

Factor Analysis and Measurement Invariance with Categorical Data in R led by Kevin Grimm (Department of Psychology, Arizona State University) is now available as an on-demand streaming seminar. This seminar explores Factor Analysis and Measurement Invariance with Categorical Data, providing a comprehensive understanding of item factor analysis models and their evaluation using the lavaan package in R. Mastering these techniques is crucial for researchers to ensure meaningful comparisons across groups or over time, thereby enhancing the validity and robustness of their empirical findings. Participants will gain practical skills in specifying and interpreting these advanced models within lavaan, directly enabling them to apply robust measurement and comparison methods to their own latent variable analyses.

Access this seminar at your own pace and please share this with colleagues and students who might benefit!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
